extDescription.message: A modern Lichess: a roomy layout, playful pages, your own board, pieces and sounds, and a Debrief for every game.

coachPickTitle.description: The title of the settings' coach page.

settingUiSounds.description: The setting that turns the extension's interface sounds on and off.
